integrity: Two standalone independent finite verification programs and an all-parameter proof are included; checks are same-model, not independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact support criterion and VC dimension are proved for all a,b>=1; finite shattering polynomials are verified only for specified small cases; no online dimension or all-parameter coefficient formula claimed. Historical priority and external validity remain unverified.
title: Parity-sensitive comparison shattering of two-chain interleavings
